intent.raw: Use the blind manual-poll experiment to create a new development package for a bridge to the current Codex session, with manual poll first.
intent.objective: Produce a governed design for one human-approved read/preview skill request selected as the singleton poll target in the Approval Desk, claimed by the active Codex session only after an explicit operator poll, with late skill disclosure, operator-only recovery, and separate authorization/execution receipts.
intent.operator_sentence: Build the manual poll bridge first; do not add a persistent worker yet.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The operator selected one bounded manual bridge and the source contracts plus live experiment evidence were sufficient for local design synthesis.

steps.name: Bind experiment and source context

inputs.ref: operator selection: manual poll bridge first

stop_conditions: block if the design treats chat output as a kernel execution receipt
block if the selected route silently adds a persistent worker

steps.name: Synthesize six-view manual bridge and UX
stop_conditions: block if human approval is described as successful skill execution
block if the task field can silently submit a generic default
block if the kernel resolves or loads the selected skill

steps.name: Define late-disclosure delegation and result return
stop_conditions: block if pre-claim agent responses expose requested_skill
block if more than one proposal can be ready for poll
block if duplicate claims can receive an execution packet
block if a session can release or requeue its own claim
block if a session can mint its own kernel receipt

steps.name: Validate smallest coherent bridge unit

outputs.ref: Distill verdict: pass for one manual read/preview bridge request

stop_conditions: block if L0 requires persistent workers, authenticated sessions, or mutation-capable execution
block if operator release/requeue or unattested identity is hidden

steps.name: Emit plan-ready handles and residue

outputs.ref: invoke plan from the approved decision-gated design package

stop_conditions: defer source mutation until invoke plan creates an approved work-pack
block source mutation during Invoke design mode

gates.condition: manual session bridge design dispatch validates before plan handoff
approval mints a typed authorization receipt without an execution claim, and a separate execution receipt is minted only after a valid claim-bound result
the first bridge permits only skill.invoke and preview.read and blocks mutation or network effects
the session lists or claims bridge requests only after the operator explicitly says poll
design includes six views, UX workflow, glossary consistency, experiment evidence, layering seed, dispatch trace, Distill result, and residue
Invoke design creates plan-ready artifacts only; source mutation requires approved plan and task-session
exactly one approved proposal is ready for poll, and only the operator can release and requeue an interrupted claim

boundaries.contract: Approval mints an authorization receipt and permits read-only attempts; it does not invoke the session or prove execution.
boundaries.approval_semantics_map: awaiting_approval becomes approved; authorization is consumed only when a terminal execution result is admitted

boundaries.contract: After the operator marks exactly one proposal ready and says poll, one successful atomic claim returns the task, requested skill slug, grants, and context refs; pre-claim responses omit the skill.
boundaries.owner_boundary_check: kernel owns claim and bindings; Codex owns installed skill resolution and contract execution

boundaries.contract: Session returns a bounded claim-bound terminal result; kernel validates it and alone mints the execution receipt.
boundaries.artifact_contract_bridge: bridge result schema, result artifacts, projector transition, execution receipt, workbench evidence

boundaries.to_owner: human operator and projects/ide-extension local kernel
boundaries.contract: Only the operator may release and requeue an interrupted L0 read-only claim; every attempt remains in the event ledger and no timer retries silently.
boundaries.approval_semantics_map: claimed becomes interrupted; operator release returns the envelope to approved without erasing attempt history

boundaries.contract: Design passes artifact handles and named residue only; plan creates SWUs and task-session owns implementation mutation.
boundaries.artifact_contract_bridge: architecture bundle, UX plan, glossary check, decision record, layering seed, dispatch JSON, design transport, Invoke result

authority.execution: active Codex session under manual operator trigger; task-session owns later implementation work
authority.validation: dispatch-spec, schema/projector/API tests, Playwright, and one real manual witness
authority.evidence: projects/ide-extension local kernel events, artifacts, and execution receipts
authority.promotion: owner-approved plan and layer evidence only

receipts.producer: projects/ide-extension local kernel after human approval
projects/ide-extension local kernel after result admission

state_namespaces.write_policy: transient task and skill input only; clear skill after prepare; no localStorage authority
durable envelopes, approvals, singleton ready target, claim attempts, operator releases, results, events, artifacts, receipts, and projections
receive one claim packet after explicit poll; do not persist full transcript into kernel state
read selected SKILL.md during bridge execution; bind resolved source hash in result

promotion_guardrails: Dispatch validation proves route shape only; it does not implement the bridge.
The manual bridge remains read/preview-only until an executor can enforce effect scope.
An unattested session ref must never be described as authenticated identity.
Only the human operator may select the ready target or release and requeue an interrupted claim.
Source mutation requires an approved Invoke plan and Task Session execution route.
